name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop (PMKSY-PDMC)
implementing_agency: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare & State Horticulture/Agriculture Depts
target_beneficiaries: Small, Marginal and Other Farmers across all Indian States

subsidy_rules.small_and_marginal_farmers: 55% Central/State baseline (up to 90% in Telangana TSMIP and AP; 100% for SC/ST in Telangana)
subsidy_rules.sc_st_farmers: 90% to 100% subsidy (Telangana TSMIP provides 100% for SC/ST up to 5 acres)

water_savings_potential: 40% to 60% water savings compared to traditional flood irrigation; 20-30% yield boost
eligibility_criteria: Cultivable land holding with functional water source (borewell, open well, or farm pond)
Electricity connection or solar pump setup
One-time benefit per survey land holding for 7 years
current_status: Active across all States under revised PMKSY 2.0 framework

name: PM-KUSUM Component B (Standalone Off-Grid Solar Agriculture Pumps)
implementing_agency: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) & State Nodal Agencies (TSREDCO, MEDA, etc.)
target_beneficiaries: Individual farmers with agricultural land and water source without grid electricity connection

subsidy_rules.state_subsidy: 30% State Govt Share (increases to 50% in NE/Hill States/Tribal Regions)
subsidy_rules.farmer_share: 10% to 40% (remaining can be financed through bank loans under Agri Infrastructure Fund)

eligible_systems: 3 HP, 5 HP, 7.5 HP Standalone DC/AC Surface and Submersible Solar Pumps
water_savings_potential: Guaranteed daytime uninterrupted irrigation; eliminates diesel pump recurring expenses (₹40,000-60,000/year savings)
eligibility_criteria: Farmer must own agricultural land with an existing open well or borewell
No existing grid power connection for the applied borewell
Land title clearance and groundwater availability certificate
documents_required: Affidavit of No Existing Grid Connection
current_status: Active pan-India; target 14 lakh standalone solar pumps extended through 2026

name: PM-KUSUM Component C (Solarisation of Grid-Connected Agricultural Pumps)
target_beneficiaries: Farmers with existing grid-connected electric pump sets

subsidy_rules.farmer_share: Remaining 40% self or financed; farmer earns income selling surplus solar power back to grid

eligible_systems: Individual Pump Solarisation & Solar Feeder segregation
water_savings_potential: Solar power day-time usage prevents wasteful night flood irrigation; solar earnings incentivize water conservation
eligibility_criteria: Valid land ownership and operational water pump
current_status: Active under DISCOM feeder solarisation drives

name: Telangana State Micro Irrigation Project (TSMIP)
target_beneficiaries: All farmers in Telangana cultivating agriculture or horticulture crops

subsidy_rules.other_farmers: 50% subsidy up to 12.5 acres max ceiling

eligible_systems: Drip for Paddy (AWD), Chilli, Cotton, Vegetable & Fruit Orchards
Micro & Raingun Sprinklers for Maize, Groundnut, Pulses
water_savings_potential: Reduces groundwater overdraft by 50%; cuts power consumption by 35%
eligibility_criteria: Farmer in Telangana with Dharani Passbook / Digital RoR
Borewell or canal lift source available
current_status: Active with ongoing allocations across all 33 Telangana districts
